data_policy: Synthetic isolated fixtures only; no business databases accessed.

local_tests.skip_reason: External MySQL/PostgreSQL connection configs are opt-in; separately executed below.

versions.postgres: PostgreSQL 17.11 on x86_64-windows, compiled by msvc-19.44.35228, 64-bit

external_tests.lifecycle: Temporary loopback-only ports, isolated data directories, SELECT-only accounts, no system services; both servers stopped by fixture finally block.

limits: Cross-page synchronization uses separate short transactions and is eventually consistent, not CDC.
IDs must be stable single-column primary keys or non-partial UNIQUE keys, with non-null ordered values; indexed text of ordinary views is unsupported.
The source must maintain updated_column; lower/backdated values and deletes need a full reconciliation.
Equal-watermark groups are replayed; very large equal groups reduce incremental efficiency.
Large source tables should have an index on (updated_column,id_column); read-only plugin never creates source indexes.
The 1127-row test verifies coverage and resumability, not a billion-row or production throughput guarantee.
PostgreSQL 16/18, real TLS, long-duration high-concurrency workloads, CDC and remote multi-node search are unverified.
